Course Matching Guidelines

A list of exchange coordinators can be found on the Global Education and Mobility tab on the student intranet under “Outbound Programmes > GEM Explorer > Exchange Coordinators”. A maximum of 20 AUs, equivalent to one full semester load, can be transferred upon return from exchange.
